question: What is the primary characteristic of a 'Fixed Income Security'?
options: Variable dividends based on profit
A contractual obligation to pay periodic interest and principal
Ownership rights in the company
High volatility compared to equity
answer: A contractual obligation to pay periodic interest and principal
hint: यह अनिवार्य रूप से (essentially) investor से issuer को दिया गया एक loan है।
explanation: Fixed income securities regular interest (coupon) payments और maturity पर principal की वापसी (return) के माध्यम से income की एक predictable stream प्रदान करते हैं।

question: The 'Coupon Rate' of a bond refers to ________.
options: The discount offered during purchase
The stated annual rate of interest paid by the issuer
The rate of inflation in the country
The commission paid to the broker
answer: The stated annual rate of interest paid by the issuer
hint: आमतौर पर face value के एक percentage के रूप में व्यक्त (expressed) किया जाता है।
explanation: Coupon rate वह fixed interest rate है जिसे bond issuer bond के mature होने तक bondholder को भुगतान करने के लिए सहमत होता है।

question: When market interest rates rise, the price of existing bonds typically ________.
options: Increases
Decreases
Remains unchanged
Becomes zero
answer: Decreases
hint: Bond prices और interest rates के बीच एक विपरीत संबंध (inverse relationship) होता है।
explanation: नए bonds higher interest प्रदान करेंगे, जिससे lower coupons वाले existing bonds कम attractive हो जाएंगे, इस प्रकार उनकी market price नीचे गिर जाएगी।

question: What is 'Face Value' (Par Value) in a bond?
options: The price at which the bond is traded in the market
The amount the issuer agrees to pay at the time of maturity
The total interest paid over the life of the bond
The tax rate applicable to the bond
answer: The amount the issuer agrees to pay at the time of maturity
hint: Interest की गणना (calculated) भी इसी राशि पर की जाती है।
explanation: Face Value bond का nominal value है जिसका उपयोग interest payments और final principal repayment की गणना (calculate) करने के लिए किया जाता है।

question: A 'Zero-Coupon Bond' is a bond that ________.
options: Pays no interest but is issued at a deep discount
Pays a very high interest rate
Has a variable interest rate
Is issued only by the RBI
answer: Pays no interest but is issued at a deep discount
hint: Profit purchase price और face value के बीच के अंतर (difference) से आता है।
explanation: Zero-coupon bonds periodic interest payments नहीं करते हैं; इसके बजाय, वे अपने face value से कम पर बेचे जाते हैं और full face value पर redeem किए जाते हैं।

question: Which of the following is considered 'Risk-Free' in the Indian context?
options: Corporate Debentures
Government Securities (G-Secs)
Fixed Deposits in Private Banks
Commercial Paper
answer: Government Securities (G-Secs)
hint: Government of India की sovereign guarantee द्वारा समर्थित (Backed)।
explanation: G-Secs में व्यावहारिक रूप से कोई credit risk (default risk) नहीं होता है क्योंकि सरकार के पास debt चुकाने के लिए tax लगाने और पैसे छापने (print money) की शक्ति (power) होती है।

question: What is 'Yield to Maturity' (YTM)?
options: The coupon rate of the bond
The total return anticipated on a bond if held until it matures
The current market price of the bond
The annual dividend paid by the bond
answer: The total return anticipated on a bond if held until it matures
hint: यह current price, coupon और time to maturity पर विचार करता है।
explanation: YTM एक bond का internal rate of return (IRR) है, यह मानते हुए कि सभी payments निर्धारित समय (scheduled) पर किए जाते हैं और उसी rate पर reinvest किए जाते हैं।

question: The risk that an issuer will not be able to make interest or principal payments is ________.
options: Interest Rate Risk
Liquidity Risk
Credit Risk (Default Risk)
Reinvestment Risk
answer: Credit Risk (Default Risk)
hint: Borrower की 'creditworthiness' (साख) से संबंधित है।
explanation: Credit risk यह खतरा है कि bond issuer financial distress का सामना करेगा और अपने debt obligations को पूरा करने में विफल रहेगा।

question: What is 'Interest Rate Risk'?
options: The risk that the issuer will default
The risk of bond price fluctuation due to changes in market interest rates
The risk that the broker will run away with the money
The risk of inflation staying low
answer: The risk of bond price fluctuation due to changes in market interest rates
hint: मुख्य रूप से long term के लिए रखे गए bonds को प्रभावित करता है।
explanation: यह fixed income investors के लिए सबसे आम risk है; जब rates ऊपर जाती हैं, तो आपके fixed-rate bond का market value कम हो जाता है।

question: A 'Call Option' in a bond allows ________.
options: The investor to sell the bond back to the issuer early
The issuer to redeem the bond before its maturity date
The government to tax the interest twice
The broker to increase their commission
answer: The issuer to redeem the bond before its maturity date
hint: Interest rates गिरने पर Issuers bond को वापस 'call' कर लेते हैं।
explanation: एक callable bond issuer को debt को जल्दी (early) चुकाने का अधिकार देता है, आमतौर पर lower interest rate पर refinance करने के लिए।

question: A 'Put Option' in a bond allows ________.
options: The issuer to cancel the bond
The bondholder to demand early repayment from the issuer
The bond to be converted into equity
The interest rate to be increased automatically
answer: The bondholder to demand early repayment from the issuer
hint: Investors bond को वापस issuer के पास 'put' कर देते हैं।
explanation: एक putable bond investor को maturity से पहले एक pre-specified price पर company को bond वापस बेचने का अधिकार देता है।

question: What are 'Convertible Bonds'?
options: Bonds that can be converted into cash at any time
Bonds that can be converted into equity shares of the company
Bonds that can be changed into gold
Bonds that have no maturity date
answer: Bonds that can be converted into equity shares of the company
hint: वे equity के upside के साथ debt की safety प्रदान करते हैं।
explanation: Convertible bonds धारक (holder) को आमतौर पर अपने विवेक (discretion) पर एक पूर्व निर्धारित (predetermined) संख्या में common shares के लिए debt का आदान-प्रदान (exchange) करने की अनुमति देते हैं।

question: Which of the following has the shortest maturity?
options: Dated Government Securities
Commercial Paper
Treasury Bills (T-Bills)
Corporate Debentures
answer: Treasury Bills (T-Bills)
hint: ये 91, 182 या 364 दिनों के लिए जारी किए गए money market instruments हैं।
explanation: T-Bills short-term debt instruments हैं जिनका उपयोग सरकार द्वारा short-term liquidity को manage करने के लिए किया जाता है।

question: What is 'Reinvestment Risk'?
options: The risk of losing the principal amount
The risk that future coupons will be reinvested at a lower rate than the YTM
The risk that the stock market will crash
The risk of taxes increasing
answer: The risk that future coupons will be reinvested at a lower rate than the YTM
hint: गिरते (falling) interest rate वाले माहौल (environment) में होता है।
explanation: यदि interest rates गिरती हैं, तो investment से प्राप्त cash flows (interest) को lower rate पर reinvest करना पड़ सकता है।

question: Which entity provides 'Credit Ratings' for bonds in India?
options: SEBI
RBI
CRISIL / ICRA
NSE
answer: CRISIL / ICRA
hint: ये specialized agencies हैं जो default risk का आकलन (assess) करती हैं।
explanation: Credit rating agencies issuers की creditworthiness का मूल्यांकन (evaluate) करती हैं और उनके debt instruments को ratings (जैसे AAA, AA, BBB) प्रदान करती हैं।

question: What does a 'AAA' rating for a bond signify?
options: Highest safety and lowest credit risk
High risk and high returns
The bond is about to default
The bond has no maturity
answer: Highest safety and lowest credit risk
hint: यह investment-grade ratings का शीर्ष स्तर (top tier) है।
explanation: AAA rated bonds को financial obligations की timely servicing के संबंध में सुरक्षा का उच्चतम स्तर (highest degree of safety) माना जाता है।

question: Bonds that are rated 'BB' or below are generally called ________.
options: Investment Grade Bonds
Junk Bonds (Speculative Grade)
Sovereign Bonds
Blue-chip Bonds
answer: Junk Bonds (Speculative Grade)
hint: इनमें higher risk होता है लेकिन higher interest rates प्रदान करते हैं।
explanation: Junk bonds (high-yield bonds) में default का higher risk होता है और इसलिए उन्हें 'investment grade' नहीं माना जाता है।

question: What is 'Accrued Interest'?
options: The total interest paid since the bond was issued
The interest earned but not yet paid since the last coupon date
The penalty for late payment
The interest earned on reinvesting coupons
answer: The interest earned but not yet paid since the last coupon date
hint: Coupon dates के बीच bond खरीदने/बेचने पर प्रासंगिक (Relevant) होता है।
explanation: जब coupon dates के बीच कोई bond बेचा जाता है, तो buyer आमतौर पर seller को वह interest देता है जो पिछले भुगतान के बाद से जमा (accumulated) हुआ है।

question: A 'Floating Rate Bond' has a coupon that ________.
options: Is fixed for the entire life of the bond
Changes periodically based on a benchmark rate
Is paid in gold instead of cash
Depends on the company's stock price
answer: Changes periodically based on a benchmark rate
hint: Rate market conditions के साथ 'float' करता है।
explanation: Floating rate bonds में variable coupons होते हैं जो Repo Rate या T-Bill rate जैसे reference rate से जुड़े (linked) होते हैं।

question: The 'Tenure' or 'Maturity' of a bond is ________.
options: The age of the bond issuer
The time period until the principal is repaid
The time it takes to get a credit rating
The daily trading hours for bonds
answer: The time period until the principal is repaid
hint: जब bond 'मर जाता है' (dies) या समाप्त हो जाता है।
explanation: Maturity वह तिथि है जिस पर principal (और अंतिम interest) का भुगतान करने का issuer का दायित्व (obligation) समाप्त हो जाता है।

question: What is 'Current Yield'?
options: Coupon / Face Value
Coupon / Current Market Price
Face Value / Coupon
Market Price / Face Value
answer: Coupon / Current Market Price
hint: Current price पर तत्काल (immediate) return की गणना करता है।
explanation: Current yield annual coupon को उस कीमत से जोड़ता है जो आप आज bond के लिए भुगतान करते हैं, capital gains या losses को अनदेखा (ignoring) करते हुए।

question: In fixed income, 'Duration' is a measure of ________.
options: The number of years until the bond matures
The sensitivity of a bond's price to a change in interest rates
The total number of coupons to be paid
The time it takes to sell a bond
answer: The sensitivity of a bond's price to a change in interest rates
hint: वर्षों (years) में व्यक्त किया जाता है, लेकिन price risk का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।
explanation: Modified Duration investors को यह समझने में मदद करता है कि interest rates में प्रत्येक 1% बदलाव के लिए bond की price कितनी move करेगी।

question: Which bond is most sensitive to interest rate changes?
options: A 1-year bond
A 10-year bond
A 30-year bond
A 3-month T-Bill
answer: A 30-year bond
hint: Tenure जितना लंबा होगा, sensitivity (duration) उतनी ही अधिक होगी।
explanation: Long-term bonds में higher duration होता है, जिसका अर्थ है कि interest rates के move होने पर उनकी कीमतें अधिक महत्वपूर्ण रूप से उतार-चढ़ाव (fluctuate) करती हैं।

question: What is a 'Perpetual Bond'?
options: A bond that matures in 100 years
A bond with no fixed maturity date
A bond that pays interest every day
A bond issued only to promoters
answer: A bond with no fixed maturity date
hint: Issuer अनिश्चित काल (indefinitely) तक interest देता है और शायद कभी भी principal वापस न करे।
explanation: Perpetual bonds (जैसे AT-1 bonds) की कोई maturity नहीं होती है; issuer हमेशा interest देता रहता है जब तक कि वे bond को 'call' करने का विकल्प न चुनें।

question: What is 'Inflation-Indexed Bonds' (IIBs)?
options: Bonds where the interest rate is always 0%
Bonds where principal and interest are adjusted for inflation
Bonds that cause inflation in the economy
Bonds issued only during recessions
answer: Bonds where principal and interest are adjusted for inflation
hint: वे investor की purchasing power की रक्षा करते हैं।
explanation: IIBs एक return प्रदान करते हैं जो एक inflation index (जैसे WPI या CPI) से जुड़ा (linked) होता है, जो return की एक real rate सुनिश्चित करता है।

question: Which of the following is a 'Money Market' instrument?
options: Equity Shares
Certificate of Deposit (CD)
Residential Real Estate
Gold ETF
answer: Certificate of Deposit (CD)
hint: Short-term, liquid और banks द्वारा जारी किए जाते हैं।
explanation: CDs short-term funding के लिए scheduled commercial banks द्वारा जारी किए गए negotiable money market instruments हैं।

question: What does 'Sovereign Risk' refer to?
options: The risk of a company going bankrupt
The risk of a national government defaulting on its debt
The risk of the stock market falling
The risk of a change in management
answer: The risk of a national government defaulting on its debt
hint: 'Sovereign' या राज्य (state) से संबंधित है।
explanation: हालांकि विकसित देशों (developed nations) के लिए आमतौर पर कम होता है, sovereign risk यह संभावना है कि एक central government अपने debt obligations को पूरा नहीं करेगी।

question: What is 'Basis Point' (bps)?
options: 1% change
0.1% change
0.01% change
10% change
answer: 0.01% change
explanation: Basis points finance में interest rates और अन्य percentages के लिए माप की एक सामान्य इकाई (common unit of measure) हैं।

question: If a bond is trading at a 'Premium', it means ________.
options: Its market price is higher than its face value
Its market price is lower than its face value
It pays no interest
It is only available to premium customers
answer: Its market price is higher than its face value
hint: आमतौर पर तब होता है जब bond का coupon current market rates से अधिक होता है।
explanation: एक bond premium पर trade करता है जब इसकी stated interest rate बाजार के बाकी हिस्सों की तुलना में अधिक attractive होती है।

question: If a bond is trading at a 'Discount', it means ________.
options: Its market price is higher than its face value
Its market price is lower than its face value
The issuer is giving a gift to the investor
The bond is tax-free
answer: Its market price is lower than its face value
hint: आमतौर पर तब होता है जब bond का coupon current market rates से कम होता है।
explanation: एक bond discount पर trade करता है जब उसका coupon rate प्रचलित (prevailing) interest rates से कम होता है, जिससे यह कम वांछनीय (desirable) हो जाता है।

question: What is 'Liquidity Risk' in the bond market?
options: The risk of the bond issuer defaulting
The risk of not being able to sell the bond quickly at a fair price
The risk of interest rates falling
The risk of the bond being called
answer: The risk of not being able to sell the bond quickly at a fair price
hint: कुछ corporate bonds के बहुत कम buyers और sellers होते हैं।
explanation: Liquidity risk corporate bond market में महत्वपूर्ण है जहां equity market की तुलना में trading volumes बहुत कम हो सकते हैं।

question: A 'Debenture' that is secured by specific assets of the company is called ________.
options: Unsecured Debenture
Mortgage Debenture (Secured)
Convertible Debenture
Perpetual Debenture
answer: Mortgage Debenture (Secured)
hint: Lender को higher safety प्रदान करता है।
explanation: Secured debentures company के fixed या current assets पर एक charge द्वारा समर्थित (backed) होते हैं।

question: What is the 'Clean Price' of a bond?
options: The price including accrued interest
The market price excluding accrued interest
The price after paying all taxes
The face value of the bond
answer: The market price excluding accrued interest
hint: यह वह price है जिसे आमतौर पर news में quote किया जाता है।
explanation: Clean Price bond की अपनी price है, जिसमें पिछले भुगतान के बाद से जमा (built up) हुए interest पर विचार नहीं किया जाता है।

question: What is the 'Dirty Price' (or All-in Price) of a bond?
options: The price of a bond that has defaulted
The Clean Price + Accrued Interest
The price after brokerage charges
The price during a market crash
answer: The Clean Price + Accrued Interest
hint: यह वह actual राशि है जो buyer seller को भुगतान करता है।
explanation: Dirty Price settlement date तक seller द्वारा अर्जित (earned) interest सहित bond की total cost को दर्शाता है।

question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of 'Government Securities'?
options: High liquidity
No default risk
High credit risk
Available in various maturities
answer: High credit risk
hint: वे देश में सबसे सुरक्षित (safest) investment हैं।
explanation: G-Secs को सुरक्षा (safety) के लिए benchmark माना जाता है और इनमें credit risk नहीं होता है।

question: What is the 'Yield Curve'?
options: A chart showing stock price movements
A graph plotting yields of bonds with different maturities but same credit quality
The path a bond takes during delivery
A measure of a company's profit growth
answer: A graph plotting yields of bonds with different maturities but same credit quality
hint: आमतौर पर 1 से 30 साल तक के G-Sec yields को plot करता है।
explanation: Yield curve interest rates और debt के time to maturity के बीच संबंध का एक दृश्य प्रतिनिधित्व (visual representation) है।

question: A 'Normal' yield curve is ________.
options: Flat
Downward sloping (inverted)
Upward sloping
A circle
answer: Upward sloping
hint: Long-term rates आमतौर पर short-term rates से अधिक होती हैं।
explanation: एक healthy economy में, investors लंबे समय (longer periods) के लिए अपना पैसा lock करने के लिए higher yields की मांग करते हैं।

question: An 'Inverted' yield curve often signals ________.
options: Economic boom
High inflation
Potential economic recession
A stock market rally
answer: Potential economic recession
hint: Short-term rates long-term rates से अधिक हो जाती हैं।
explanation: एक inverted curve बताता है कि investors उम्मीद करते हैं कि धीमी आर्थिक वृद्धि (slowing economic growth) के कारण भविष्य में interest rates गिरेंगी।

question: What is a 'Commercial Paper' (CP)?
options: A newspaper for traders
An unsecured, short-term debt instrument issued by corporations
A type of equity share
A loan from the government to a company
answer: An unsecured, short-term debt instrument issued by corporations
hint: Working capital की जरूरतों को पूरा करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।
explanation: CPs का उपयोग highly-rated कंपनियों द्वारा money market से short-term funds (1 वर्ष तक) जुटाने के लिए किया जाता है।

question: What is the role of a 'Debenture Trustee'?
options: To manage the company's daily operations
To protect the interests of the debenture holders
To guarantee the stock price
To audit the government's accounts
answer: To protect the interests of the debenture holders
hint: वे lenders के लिए एक watchdog के रूप में कार्य करते हैं।
explanation: एक Debenture Trustee यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि issuer issue की शर्तों (terms) का अनुपालन (complies) करे और investors के अधिकारों (rights) की रक्षा करे।

question: Which of the following describes 'Senior Debt'?
options: Debt that is only available to senior citizens
Debt that has priority for repayment over other unsecured debt during liquidation
The oldest debt a company has
Debt that pays no interest
answer: Debt that has priority for repayment over other unsecured debt during liquidation
hint: Bankruptcy के दौरान वे लाइन में सबसे पहले होते हैं।
explanation: यदि company बंद (wound up) हो जाती है, तो 'subordinated' या 'junior' debt holders से पहले Senior debt holders को भुगतान किया जाता है।

question: What is 'Subordinated Debt'?
options: Debt that is paid before all other creditors
Debt that ranks lower in priority for repayment during liquidation
Debt issued by a subsidiary company
Debt that has a floating interest rate
answer: Debt that ranks lower in priority for repayment during liquidation
hint: Lender के लिए Higher risk, इसलिए यह आमतौर पर higher interest देता है।
explanation: दावों के पदानुक्रम (hierarchy of claims) में, senior creditors के पूरी तरह से संतुष्ट होने के बाद ही subordinated debt का भुगतान किया जाता है।

question: What is the 'Spread' in the context of corporate bonds?
options: The difference between the bond's yield and a risk-free benchmark (like G-Sec)
The difference between two different stocks
The commission the broker takes
The physical distance between two exchanges
answer: The difference between the bond's yield and a risk-free benchmark (like G-Sec)
hint: Corporate risk लेने के लिए 'risk premium' का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।
explanation: एक wider spread यह दर्शाता है कि investors corporate bond को government debt की तुलना में अधिक जोखिम भरा (riskier) मानते हैं।

question: What is 'Modified Duration'?
options: The actual age of the bond
A measure of price sensitivity per 100 bps change in yield
The time left for the next coupon
The number of times the bond has been traded
answer: A measure of price sensitivity per 100 bps change in yield
hint: Macaulay Duration से लिया गया (Derived)।
explanation: Modified duration वह टूल है जिसका उपयोग yield में दिए गए बदलाव के लिए bond की price में percentage change का अनुमान लगाने के लिए किया जाता है।

question: If a bond has a duration of 5 years and interest rates rise by 1%, its price will roughly ________.
options: Rise by 5%
Fall by 5%
Rise by 1%
Stay the same
answer: Fall by 5%
hint: Price Change % ≈ -Duration * Yield Change %।
explanation: Inverse relationship के कारण, rates में वृद्धि (increase) से duration के अनुपात में (proportional) price में कमी (decrease) आती है।

question: What is 'Credit Enhancement'?
options: Increasing the interest rate on a bond
Improving the credit profile of a debt issue through external support (like a guarantee)
Falsifying the company's financial records
Buying more bonds to reduce risk
answer: Improving the credit profile of a debt issue through external support (like a guarantee)
hint: Issuer को बेहतर rating प्राप्त करने में मदद करता है।
explanation: Credit enhancement में bond को investors के लिए अधिक सुरक्षित बनाने के लिए bank guarantees, insurance या collateral शामिल हो सकते हैं।

question: What is 'Tax-Free Bonds'?
options: Bonds where you don't pay any capital gains tax
Bonds where the interest income is exempt from income tax
Bonds issued by the Income Tax department
Bonds that are given for free by the government
answer: Bonds where the interest income is exempt from income tax
hint: अक्सर NHAI या REC जैसी government-backed entities द्वारा जारी किया जाता है।
explanation: हालांकि interest tax-free है, लेकिन exchange पर bond को बेचने से होने वाला कोई भी capital gains अभी भी taxable है।

question: What is 'Callable Bond' risk for the investor?
options: The risk of losing the principal
The risk that the bond will be redeemed when interest rates are low
The risk of the company going public
The risk of the bond price rising too much
answer: The risk that the bond will be redeemed when interest rates are low
hint: Investor को प्रचलित दरों (prevailing rates) को कम करने पर reinvest करने के लिए मजबूर (Forces) करता है।
explanation: यह अनिवार्य रूप से 'reinvestment risk' है जो issuer द्वारा loan को जल्दी वापस भुगतान करने के अपने अधिकार का प्रयोग (exercising) करने से उत्पन्न (triggered) होता है।

question: What is 'Macaulay Duration'?
options: The total profit from a bond
The weighted average time to receive all cash flows from a bond
The name of the person who invented bonds
The current market price of the bond
answer: The weighted average time to receive all cash flows from a bond
hint: यह interest rate risk के 'time' element को मापता है।
explanation: यह आपको उस समय का बिंदु (point in time) बताता है जहां एक investor rates के move होने पर bond की price change पर break even करेगा।

question: Which of the following is a key component of a bond's 'Indenture'?
options: Maturity date and coupon rate
Rights and obligations of the issuer and bondholder
Collateral and restrictive covenants
All of the above
answer: All of the above
hint: यह issuer और investors के बीच legal contract है।
explanation: Trust deed या indenture में debt instrument की शर्तों (terms and conditions) के बारे में सभी fine print शामिल होते हैं।
